skyrally.archetype: Figure-8 crossing, item duel at the cross

skyrally.title: Frozen River Peak

deck.note: kind none: open flight line over the river, plateau and lake (the guide shows no road)

allowPockets.note: SNOW-1 hidden-key notch behind the west pier (key 76 studs off the line, shrine niche 135)

alternates.note: mine tunnel through the west gorge wall (timber roof, lantern strip)

key.note: behind the over/under stone arch on the under route: a notch along the west gorge wall behind the west pier (fly in and out under the rock lip); shrine niche at its back

boss.note: snowballs roll down the gorge terraces, the cascade, the knoll, the east ridge and the pine slope across the line; anchors are stations, rollFrom gives the uphill release point per anchor

framing.note: first gameplay view: up the frozen river at the arch bridge with the peak above the deck, pines on the rims (05_SNOW1_EVERFROST_PEAK.png composition)
